notes: Reindent-after-fuzzy-match ladder. Helpers (_leading_whitespace, _first_meaningful_line) linked from the real port; reindent body is a faithful traced copy of fuzzy_match_helpers.c::fuzzy_match_reindent_replacement. Each input is one case encoded as region\x1fold\x1fnew (multi-line fields allowed). C compares indent by count+strncmp prefix; LIVE compares indent prefix strings — equivalent for space/tab-only indents, which all inputs use. Cases cover: indent swap, no-op equal indent, empty region/old/new, blank lines, dedent anchoring, nesting.
